I don’t have the ability to browse the web in real time. My training includes information up to 2024-06 and I can’t fetch live pages, check current prices/news, or follow links from here.

How I can help instead
- Summarize or analyze text or screenshots you paste or upload.
- Suggest precise search queries and tips to find reliable sources.
- Explain how to verify information, interpret sources, or compare claims.
- Answer questions based on knowledge up to 2024-06 and general reasoning.

If you want live info, paste the text or link you care about (or upload a screenshot) and I’ll analyze it. If you need help searching, tell me what you’re looking for and I’ll draft search queries and a checklist for assessing results.
